scope: synthetic development transfer, not ARC or S6 certification

acceptance.instrument: tests pass; all witnesses valid; original sources unchanged; deterministic replay and independent arithmetic audit
acceptance.module_advantage: paired additional exact successes without regressions, or equal successes at lower total logical work including acquisition
acceptance.uncertainty: paired wins and losses, descriptive Wilson intervals; correlated families are not independent evidence of broad generalization
acceptance.adversarial_advantage: adaptive must improve over random at the same total work ceiling; ties and higher costs are negative or inconclusive
acceptance.promotion: none; neither S6 green nor official ECHO-5 scientific release follows automatically
